items.text: A career guidance questionnaire helps students reflect on interests, strengths, values and constraints by asking short, clear questions, and it is useful only if it is designed with care, scored simply and used as a conversation starter, never as a final verdict.
Cover interests, skills, values and practical constraints, keep wording simple, and discuss results with the student, family and a teacher.
Do not label students or promise outcomes based on a questionnaire.
